Objective: To propose a three-stage anomaly detection approach for IoT wearable healthcare devices using an ensemble of K-Means++ clustering and Random Forest classification to improve detection efficiency and accuracy.

Title: A Unified AI Framework for Confidentiality Preserving Cyberattack Detection in Healthcare Cyber Physical Networks
Integration Mechanism: parallel-vote — supervised and unsupervised models generate predictions independently, then ensemble voting aggregates predictions using weighted voting: ŷ = argmax_c Σm wm·Pm(c)

Objective: To propose a unified IDS framework integrating hybrid machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, ensemble) with adaptive differential privacy for detecting cyberattacks including zero-day threats in Healthcare Cyber-Physical Systems while preserving patient data confidentiality.

Title: A privacy-aware framework for detecting cyber attacks on internet of medical things systems using data fusion and quantu
